title: Poison Spore
summary: Refine spores into the extract for Noxious Spore Grenade.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Poison Spores into Sublimate of Poison Spores. Combine with any Ash to make Noxious Spore Grenade.
fields.Result: The grenade creates a 7-ft-radius cloud for 3 turns. The fumes poison creatures that enter or start a turn inside. Fire can ignite the cloud and leave burning ground.
fields.Acquisition: Check Derryth Bonecloak or the dead myconid in the Underdark.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
